categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies ci/test/02_run_container.py to configure dynamic Docker subnets for CI containers.
categories.rationale: Prevents address collisions when developers run multiple local CI container jobs simultaneously. The change eliminates shared static IP addresses between containers, reducing developer friction when testing locally.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and updates functional bind tests to accept container subnet environment variables.
categories.rationale: Allows functional bind tests to execute concurrently in separate containers without port/address collisions. The functional test changes parameterize previously hardcoded IP addresses.
